name: Alamosa County, CO
findings: Alamosa County has 59 nonprofit organizations. 29 of them (49%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 24 organizations.
Community organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (25% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Alamosa County has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in Alamosa County list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.4 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 24 organizations here; 34% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are groups to join so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
